meta.title: Flagship Comparison Pages — University × Course Decision Engine 2026-27
meta.scope: Comparison layer only; preserve existing comparison pages and create the improved comparison experience alongside them where required.
meta.goal: Make comparison a flagship decision feature, especially clear and usable on mobile.
meta.architecture: Course Pillar → University Course → Comparison → Supporting Content

constraints: Do not delete or break existing comparison pages.
Do not create indexable pages for every possible university combination.
Do not make unsupported best/winner claims.
Do not invent fees, rankings, recognition, placements, salaries, curriculum or scholarships.
All dynamic comparison values must come from the verified university-course data layer.
Show academic session and last verified date.
Keep Online and ODL/distance programmes distinct.
Use Not published instead of blank cells.
Comparison is a decision tool, not a giant SEO article.

course_comparison.purpose: Compare multiple universities offering the same course.

selected_comparison.purpose: Compare user-selected programmes without generating thousands of indexable URLs.
selected_comparison.indexation: Only approved evergreen comparison landing pages are indexable.

mobile_ux.core: Side-by-side comparison without messy stacked cards.
mobile_ux.layout: Horizontally scrollable comparison matrix with sticky first comparison-label column and horizontally scrollable university columns.
flow: Collapsible groups: Overview, Fees, Academics, Admission, Exams, Support, Career
Keep source/verified indicator close to dynamic values
mobile_ux.overflow: Never allow body-level horizontal overflow. Use an isolated scroll container with a clear scroll affordance.

summary_logic.rule: Use labels such as lowest verified fee, never best or winner. Do not calculate a highlight when data is incomplete or incomparable.

decision_framework.method: Surface factual differences. Do not use an opaque score unless its methodology and every input are transparent and verified.
language: More suitable if your priority is...

content_structure: Which option may suit which goal?
Important differences to verify before applying

seo.title_pattern: Online {COURSE} University Comparison 2026-27 — Fees, Eligibility, Curriculum & Exams
seo.meta_pattern: Compare online {COURSE} universities for 2026-27 by verified fees, eligibility, duration, curriculum, specialisations, admission, exams and learner support.
seo.canonical: Self-canonical on approved evergreen comparison pages.
schema: FAQPage only for visible valid FAQs
seo.noindex: Dynamic selected combinations, filters, sort URLs and query parameters unless deliberately promoted to an editorial landing page.

internal_linking.comparison_to_course: Every compared programme → exact canonical university-course page.

methodology: Fees, admissions, curriculum and support can change by academic session.
Official university/regulator sources are factual authority.
Missing data is not interpreted as a negative.
Comparison is factual, not a universal ranking.
Link major dynamic facts to official sources where practical.

anti_cannibalization.pillar: Broad course education and how to choose.
anti_cannibalization.blog: Narrow informational or timely search question.

qa: Mobile 320/360/375/390/414px has no body-level horizontal overflow.
2-4 universities can be compared side-by-side clearly on mobile.
First comparison-label column remains identifiable while swiping.
All dynamic values come from verified data.
Each comparison item links to its exact course page.
Sources and last verified dates are visible.
lovable_prompt:
PHASE 5 — FLAGSHIP COMPARISON EXPERIENCE ONLY

Implement the attached Phase 5 JSON.

Goal: make comparison one of the strongest UX features of the website, especially on mobile.

1. Do NOT delete or break existing comparison pages.
2. Keep existing comparison routes/content available.
3. Build the improved flagship comparison layer separately where necessary.
4. Do not change university-course or course-pillar URLs.
5. Use the verified university-course data layer as the factual source.
6. Never invent fees, eligibility, recognition, rankings, placements, salaries, curriculum or scholarships.
7. Show academic session and last verified date.
8. Keep Online and ODL/distance programmes distinct.
9. Implement the mobile matrix:
   - select 2-4 universities
   - sticky comparison-label column
   - horizontally scrollable university columns
   - grouped sections
   - clear scroll affordance
   - no body-level horizontal overflow
10. Desktop should use a clean comparison matrix, not giant cards.
11. Never declare a university best/winner.
12. Use factual highlights such as lowest verified fee only when data is complete and comparable.
13. Missing information must display Not published.
14. Add source/verification information to dynamic facts.
15. Implement the SEO/indexation rules in this JSON.
16. Avoid thousands of indexable selected-combination URLs.
17. Link each compared university to its exact canonical university-course page.
18. Add contextual links from course pillars and university-course pages into comparison.
19. Preserve existing analytics, routing and SEO infrastructure.

After implementation, return:
- routes created/updated
- existing routes preserved
- mobile QA at 320/360/375/390/414px
- desktop QA
- body-overflow test
- source/data verification
- canonical/indexation audit
- internal-link audit
- missing-data handling test
- issues requiring manual review

This is PHASE 5 ONLY. Do not implement Phase 6.
